summary_before: Software module for military aerial drones enabling dynamic engagement of moving targets with reusable UAVs.
summary_after: Software module for military drone systems that enables dynamic attack protocols: the drone releases a free-fall munition or rocket-propelled warhead while in motion and survives the mission to be reused. APS describes Fenix as still in development.

summary_before: DOME provides passive RF drone detection and monitoring.
summary_after: Drone detection as a service: a network of passive RF sensors giving real-time tracking of drone and pilot position, altitude and trajectory, cross-referenced against authorised flights for compliance monitoring. Argonian states over 87% of commercial UAS flights are identified in real time.

summary_before: Frequency-hopping mesh datalink for tactical UAV operations in GNSS-denied conditions.
summary_after: GNSS-independent, high-speed frequency-hopping mesh networking for UAV communications, built on software-defined radio with a self-forming, self-healing architecture for jammed and GNSS-denied environments.

summary_before: High-speed interceptor UAV with autonomous AI tracking and kinetic interception, described by the manufacturer as combat-proven.
summary_after: High-speed FPV interceptor for neutralising hostile aerial threats. Manufacturer states 300 km/h, autonomous AI tracking, and describes the aircraft as combat-proven.

summary_before: Unmanned aircraft in the BeeTA Technologies catalogue.
summary_after: FPV quadcopter supplied with BeeTA's WireDO fibre-optic control system already fitted, with tall landing legs and trim balanced for the spool. Manufacturer figures: payload up to 1.7 kg, 13 minutes with a 1.5 kg payload, 10 km fibre spool weighing 1.12 kg, 6s3p 15,000 mAh battery.

summary_before: UAV communications system.
summary_after: Fibre-optic control system for FPV drones. Carries control and video over optical fibre rather than a radio link. Clip-on spool in 10, 15, 20 and 30 km lengths, RJ45 control input and two AV outputs, internal 6s2p 8,000 mAh battery.

summary_before: BSS-led consortium selected for NSPA C-UAS framework.
summary_after: Passive acoustic sensor for drone detection, classification and localisation. A vertical array of high-sensitivity microphones with embedded machine learning matches sound against an acoustic library; omnidirectional, stated 5 km detection radius per unit, emits nothing and can cue other sensors and effectors.

summary_before: Hybrid unmanned aerial vehicle.
summary_after: Hybrid unmanned aerial vehicle taking several optical payload configurations; the manufacturer lists a flight duration of 150 minutes on electric motors alone.

summary_before: FPV unmanned aircraft set.
summary_after: FPV drone kit carried in a transport backpack, containing four FPV drones with their instrumentation and goggles.

summary_before: FPV strike drone line manufactured and supplied under direct contracts.
summary_after: Celebra Tech's flagship FPV strike drone line, including fibre-optic variants intended for operation under electronic warfare. The manufacturer states units are delivered ready to fly with no additional setup, under a 12-month or 50-cycle warranty.

summary_before: Own RF detection system and C-UAS event/airshow services.
summary_after: Compact, fully integrated drone-detection system designed and built in Italy. Several dual-band directional panels act as a direction finder, receiving the 2.4 and 5.8 GHz Wi-Fi bands and covering 0-6 GHz to reach the protocols and radios used by commercial drones. Supplied with its own management software.

summary_before: Hybrid UAV for ISR, group flight and air-defence training.
summary_after: Multi-platform UAV system with configurable equipment, MTOW up to 150 kg. Manufacturer figures: up to 10 platforms flown from one station, up to 10 hours endurance, 30 kg payload drop, ceiling up to 7 km, variable radar cross-section for air-defence training and a hybrid drive with low infrared signature.

summary_before: Aerial-target UAV family for air-defence training.
summary_after: Multi-platform aerial-target imitator system for air-defence training. Eurotech reports 280 VERMIN platforms manufactured and 2,000 flights flown for the Anti-Aircraft Defence Forces over 12 years.

summary_before: SIGINT and RF-detection system for locating UAV and radio emitters, developed by Falcons and deployed in Ukraine.
summary_after: Radio-electronic intelligence complex with three direction-finding systems that detect communications, drone and electronic-warfare emitters, including frequency-hopping equipment. Janes reports it runs autonomously for up to 24 hours, that units can be networked, and that crews use it to check for hostile emissions before launching a UAV.

summary_before: Explicit multi-layer soft/hard-kill C-UAS portfolio.
summary_after: Portable X-band FMCW counter-UAV radar: an ultra-lightweight, rapidly deployable 4D short-range surveillance radar that detects and tracks low, slow, small targets including FPV drones, micro-UAVs and loitering munitions. Manufacturer figures: under 15 kg, AESA antenna, 32 km maximum range, 16 km at 0.1 m2 RCS.

summary_before: Explicit multi-layer soft/hard-kill C-UAS portfolio.
summary_after: Multi-Layer Hybrid Anti-Drone System: a scalable, modular air-defence system combining soft-kill and hard-kill layers - radar detection with AI tracking, then GNSS, mobile-band and RF jamming, then the RP-24 57 mm rocket launcher - tied to a central command-and-control interface that can fuse with existing C4i.

summary_before: Explicit multi-layer soft/hard-kill C-UAS portfolio.
summary_after: Hard-kill counter-UAS rocket launcher, the elimination component of HADES's hard-kill systems. Fires a modified 57 mm S-5 rocket with an air-burst fragmentation warhead on a time-programmable fuse cued by radar and machine-learning prediction. Manufacturer figures: 3,000 m effective range, ~20 m lethal radius, 24+ rockets per pod.

summary_before: Explicit multi-layer soft/hard-kill C-UAS portfolio.
summary_after: Soft-Kill Anti-Drone System: a jammer that disrupts a UAV's control and navigation links as either an omnidirectional denial sphere or a directed long-range beam. Manufacturer figures: 1.5 MHz-7000 MHz custom coverage spanning GNSS, cellular 2G-5G and the common Wi-Fi bands, effective to 8 km, active or reactive.

summary_before: Modular multi-mission multirotor platform carrying the French Armed Forces UAF label.
summary_after: Modular tool-carrier multirotor: one standard body with interchangeable arm sets. Hexadrone lists Urban (3 kg payload, 35 min empty / 25 min loaded), Endurance (5 kg, 1 h / 30 min) and XL (6 kg), over 100 payloads connecting through the TR-Lock and TR-Module interfaces and swappable in under three minutes, IP54 testing to NF EN 60529, and the French armed forces UAF label.

summary_before: Explicit modular multi-layer C-UAS suite; NSPA framework holder.
summary_after: Modular, open-architecture counter-UAS system built around the C4PER command-and-control core, combining 3D AESA radar, EO/IR, RF detection and direction-finding, omnidirectional and directional jammers and a cyber-takeover subsystem. Stationary or mobile; interoperable with SAPIENT, Asterix and Link-16.

summary_before: Explicit modular multi-layer C-UAS suite; NSPA framework holder.
summary_after: Counter-UAS command-and-control software at the core of the ANDROMEDA system. Fuses RF detector, radar and EO/IR data for detection, identification and localisation, manages sensors and effectors and automates engagement, with map display of tracks, predicted flight paths and geo-fencing alerts. Supports SAPIENT, Link-16, Asterix and JREAP-C.

summary_before: Manufacturer reports 2,500+ detectors sold.
summary_after: Portable personal drone detector worn on the body. Monitors the 0.9, 1.2, 2.4 and 4.9-6.0 GHz bands through omnidirectional antennas for 360-degree coverage and warns by light, vibration and sound. Manufacturer figures: detection to 1,000 m, 4-6 second scan, 6 hours or more of battery life.

summary_before: Loitering munition.
summary_after: Infantry-carried loitering munition developed with the Military Institute of Armament Technology (WITU). One soldier carries and operates it: a 200x200x1350 mm container doubling as the launcher, the air vehicle, a ground control station and a tracking antenna. Reported: 5.8 kg flight mass, ~30 min endurance, over 10 km range, GX-4 warhead family.

summary_before: Flagship multirotor unmanned aircraft for commercial and defence use.
summary_after: Robodrone's flagship multirotor: a low-profile airframe with folding arms built from lightweight carbon composites, for commercial and defence use. The Czech investment agency catalogue lists a range of up to 14 km and a 4 kg maximum take-off weight.

summary_before: Vision-based, GPS-free, EW-resilient onboard autonomy module for drones.
summary_after: Drone autonomy software for ISR, loitering munitions, counter-UAS and perimeter security. Robotto lists GNSS-denied operation, autonomous mission safeguards, target selection and re-selection, air-to-ground terminal navigation, cruise control, optical zoom and static and dynamic tracking; hardware-agnostic.

summary_before: Portable 360-degree RF suppression station against UAV control and video links.
summary_after: Portable RF jamming station against FPV control and video links. Manufacturer figures: 300-1020 MHz in seven sub-bands plus 2100-2400, 2400-2700 and 5725-5850 MHz; suppression to 250 m; deployable in under 5 minutes; 25.6 V 4,500 Wh LiFePO4 battery giving at least 60 minutes; passive cooling; 20 kg.

summary_before: Long-range VTOL UAV up to 25 kg MTOW for surveillance, threat detection and light cargo.
summary_after: Long-range airframe UAV with vertical take-off and landing and a 25 kg maximum take-off weight, offered in a hybrid version (combustion engine for forward flight with electric VTOL motors) and an all-electric version.

summary_before: Autonomous C-UAS detection/tracking; FoxHUNTER deliveries planned 2027.
summary_after: Rapid-deploy counter-UAS system for dense urban areas and critical infrastructure. Fuses RF, radar, vision and acoustic sensors for real-time detection of drones and their pilots, with AI threat classification and a C2 interface, in mobile, fixed or covert configurations. TrackDeep states coverage up to an 18 km perimeter radius.

summary_before: Autonomous C-UAS detection/tracking; FoxHUNTER deliveries planned 2027.
summary_after: RF geolocation sensor network that locates radio emitters, including encrypted drones such as DJI OcuSync 4, by TDoA multilateration across sensor nodes, with trajectory analysis separating drones from ground emitters. Protocol-agnostic, needing no signal library. TrackDeep states roughly 200-450 km2 per network. Not yet in general availability: offered pre-sale, with deliveries planned from spring 2027.

summary_before: Autonomous C-UAS detection/tracking; FoxHUNTER deliveries planned 2027.
summary_after: Receiver for real-time detection, tracking and identification of drones and their pilots. Continuously scans for Remote ID and DJI DroneID broadcasts and alerts on them, showing both aircraft and operator position. Manufacturer figures: up to 15 km omnidirectional and 30 km directional, 2.4 GHz standard with optional 5.8 GHz, IP67.

summary_before: UAV communications product.
summary_after: UAV mission simulator that models terrain, weather, communication constraints and platform behaviour, for operator training, mission planning and technology testing without risk to people or equipment.

summary_before: UAV navigation product.
summary_after: Visual navigation module giving GPS-independent positioning by matching real-time terrain imagery from onboard cameras against preloaded digital maps; the manufacturer states 5-30 m accuracy, day and night, in GNSS-denied conditions.

summary_before: UAV simulation product.
summary_after: Video and data transmission module that digitises analogue video feeds and transmits them with telemetry and mission data over a secure radio link; the manufacturer states ranges above 30 km, with in-flight adjustment of channel and power.

summary_before: Own aerial platform offered in reconnaissance and bomber configurations.
summary_after: Two-aircraft kit: a bomber UAV for precision strikes and a reconnaissance UAV. The manufacturer lists up to 2 kg carried by the bomber and 90x zoom on the reconnaissance aircraft, supplied with a ground control station, two navigation beacons, two controllers, three 6S4P batteries, charging equipment and a transport case.

summary_before: HILDR pilot order from Swedish FMV; series development ongoing.
summary_after: Autonomous close-range counter-drone system that detects, tracks, classifies and neutralises drones. Valkyr states an engagement range of 0-30 m, fusing optical, infrared, acoustic and RF sensing with AI detection and an electrically controlled dual-mode effector, mountable on vehicles, containers or fixed installations. Valkyr reports a pilot order from the Swedish FMV, with series development ongoing.

summary_before: Company markets dedicated anti-drone radar products.
summary_after: Compact anti-drone radar with four fixed antenna faces, each carrying one S-VBR module. VirtuaLabs figures: minimum range 0.1 km, up to 1.5 km against a micro-drone (0.001 m2 RCS), 3 km against a small drone (0.01 m2) and 10 km against a large drone (1 m2).
